test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(A) he had to take the bus

(B) his friend, who used to give

(C) to his office because he had

(D) him a lift, was on vacation

(E) never learned to drive and
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **ACEBD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence logically starts with part (A) "he had to take the bus," which introduces the action taken by the subject.
 
• Next follows part (C) "to his office because he had," which provides the reason for the action in part (A).
 
• Then part (E) "never learned to drive and," offers additional information about the subject’s inability.
 
• Part (B) "his friend, who used to give," introduces the friend who used to assist him.
 
• Finally, part (D) "him a lift, was on vacation," completes the sentence by explaining why the assistance was unavailable.

Therefore, the correct answer is **ACEBD**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (DACEB):** This option disrupts the logical flow by starting with the reason for the action rather than the action itself.
 
• **Option 3 (EBADC):** This option disrupts the logical flow by starting with the subject’s inability rather than the action or reason.
 
• **Option 4 (BADEC):** This option disrupts the logical flow by starting with the subject’s friend rather than the action itself.
